thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: p99 latency alert fired for /v1/generate (eu-west-1) — threshold breached (SLO=300ms)
pagerduty: Incident created: PD-INGEST-8392 — multiple p99 spikes in last 2m, auto-escalation in 5m if not acked
Sasha: acked. I'm on it. grabbing graphs
Mike (Oncall): thx. quick check — is this only eu-west or global?
Julia: looks concentrated eu-west app-backend pool. p95 also nudging upward but p99 is the problem. traces show long queue wait times + a lot of new container restarts in the last 6m
Priya: could be preemptions on the spot pool or a bad deploy. I don't see a deploy in last 30m though.
Tomas: checking autoscaler history now. hmm, cooldowns hit, we had repeated scale-in attempts at 02:14 that dropped capacity then a bunch of requests queued -> latency tail.
Sasha: can someone check node preemptions / instance termination events?
Mike (Oncall): running: `gcloud compute instances operations list --filter="zone:(europe-west1-b) status=TERMINATED" --limit=50` and checking cloud logs
ops-bot: Found 7 preemptions in europe-west1-b between 02:12 and 02:18 — reason: spot termination notice
Julia: confirmed. autoscaler policy allowed aggressive scale-in + spot-backed node group. that explains the restarts and KV cache cold misses
Priya: immediate mitigation options: 1) route a fraction of eu-west traffic to eu-fallback (lower-latency variant on dedicated) 2) temporarily increase min replicas on eu-west pool 3) warm KV cache by synthetic warmups once nodes ready
Tomas: I can bump min replicas now. executing:
```
# increase min nodes to 6
redwoodctl infra set-min --region eu-west-1 --pool app-backend --min 6
```
Tomas: command succeeded, requested nodes are provisioning (ETA ~90s)
Sasha: creating a temporary route override to send 20% traffic to eu-fallback model-quantized (lower mem, faster). doing via console patch now
Mike (Oncall): please post the route command / link
Sasha: patch:
```
PATCH /routing/policies/production
{"rules": [{"match":"region==eu-west-1","weight":{"eu-fallback":20,"primary":80}}]
}
```
Sasha: applied. verify with: `curl -s https://console.internal/routing/status | jq .eu-west-1`
Mike (Oncall): seeing fallback handling ~18% now. p99 started dropping from 1.1s -> 420ms in the last 40s. still above SLO but trending down
Julia: KV cache miss rate dropped once nodes started booting. We still have some cold KV entries for hot keys. synthetic warmups lined up:
```
for k in $(cat hot_keys.txt); do curl -s -X POST https://eu-west-1.internal/cache/warm -d "$k" & done
```
Priya: PagerDuty: can you hold escalation? I'll mark PD incident notes: mitigations in flight, acked by Sasha
pagerduty: Escalation paused at request of on-call (Sasha). Auto-escalation window extended by 10m
Sasha: quick diag — traces show a small subset of customers hitting a slow model variant path (fallback to CPU fallback), I'm going to trigger a targeted reroute to avoid that variant for heavy customers
Tomas: rolling a hotfix to autoscaler policy to prevent scale-in when preemption spike detected. pushing policy change:
```
# new policy: grace on recent preemptions
redwoodctl autoscaler update --region eu-west-1 --policy "grace_window: 300"
```
Tomas: policy update accepted. this prevents scale-in for 5m after preemption spike detection
Mike (Oncall): system metrics look better. p99 now ~280ms for the last 1m window. p95 steady ~120ms.
Julia: customer impact check — no errors, just latency. downstream SLAs unaffected but some interactive UIs might have perceived slowness. flagged product for awareness @julia to ping support if we see customer DMs
Priya: logging notes: recorded as 'eu-west spot preemptions causing autoscale oscillation -> cold KV cache -> p99 tail' for incident tracking
Sasha: paging status? should we start handoff to next rotation or keep team until stable for 15m?
Mike (Oncall): keep oncall assigned until next check in 15m. if p99 stays <300ms for two consecutive 1m windows, we can unassign and file ticket for autoscaler config + avoid spot for critical pools
ops-bot: Note added to PD: mitigation applied (route override, min replica bump, autoscaler policy change), monitoring for 15m
Sasha: quick customer note drafted for support (short): "We observed elevated response latency in EU. Traffic rerouted and capacity increased; we are monitoring. No errors. Follow-up will be posted." posted to #support-desk
Priya: follow-ups: - postmortem on autoscaler policy and spot usage - consider reserving small dedicated pool for critical low-latency paths - add synthetic warmers to startup hooks
Tomas: leaving this thread for now, I'll be on standby if automation reports a regression.
Mike (Oncall): 15m check: p99 averaged 265ms over last 15m, no new preemptions. I am clearing the PD incident to 'resolved - mitigated' once we confirm stable for another 10m
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-INGEST-8392 marked RESOLVED by mike_sre — resolution: rerouted traffic, increased min replicas, updated autoscaler policy; follow-ups assigned
Sasha: thanks team. will create a postmortem ticket with links to graphs and commands used. closing thread when postmortem ticket is up
Julia: adding runbook note: disable aggressive scale-in for spot-backed pools that serve low-latency endpoints
Priya: +1. good catch.
Sasha: closing now, moving follow-ups to TICKET-5421. good job everyone :thumbsup:
